images.initialPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / terrain extension. Input image 1 is the existing approved cemetery path sprite and is the material/style reference. Input image 2 is the existing game scene, CONTEXT ONLY. Produce ONLY a new supporting soil layer for the earth BEHIND gravestones and iron fencing, NOT the whole scene and NOT a path. Isolated wide shallow horizontal strip, usable in the same side-view pixel-art cemetery. The visible strip must have an approximately 8:1 width:height silhouette, use almost the full image width, and leave transparent space above an irregular broken upper boundary. Surface is a low-angle shallow floor receding away, not a tall vertical wall: dark neutral grey-brown compact soil, small grey stone chips and occasional flat worn grey stepping stones, subdued tan leaf litter and a few thin exposed roots. Very restrained, quiet contrast behind pale crosses. Dry matte material, finely clustered pixel-art strokes matching the existing path. Ground must remain predominantly soil and grey stone: no moss blanket, no grass carpet, NO GREEN background. Only extremely sparse tiny dried grass tufts at widely spaced spots, no flowers, no ferns, no mushrooms, no tombs, no crosses, no fence, no buildings, no text. Avoid a straight horizontal top edge, repeated evenly spaced stones, bright pebbles, liquid, slime, fog, shiny mud, smooth gradients. Entire left and right edge must continue at the same ground level so this strip can be joined to its mirror. Lower part of strip must be solid soil, no floating disconnected pieces. Transparent background outside terrain. We are deriving a companion ground layer from the approved terrain while preserving the original path unchanged.
images.finalPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied isolated cemetery soil strip. Keep its horizontal extent, subdued dark grey-brown soil and grey stone palette, fine clustered pixel-art style, dry leaf litter and sparse dried grass. MAIN CORRECTION: the current strip is much too shallow and looks like a platform cross-section. Make the soil area approximately TWICE AS THICK vertically: in this same 2126x740 canvas the actual soil silhouette should occupy about 320 pixels of height, from about y=330 to y=650, and span the full width. Depict a low-angle patch of ground receding away behind graves: broad irregular floor area with earth texture, very occasional flat small grey stones and scattered tan leaves. Upper silhouette stays ragged and natural, transparent above it; bottom fills the entire ground area solidly. Do not add a straight retaining wall or a platform rim. Remove the conspicuous vertical cutaway root drawings; instead use a few thin exposed roots lying across the surface, irregular directions. No new grass carpet, no moss blanket, NO GREEN mass, no flowers, no ferns, no mushrooms, no graves, no fence, no buildings, no text. Do not tile or duplicate the current strip into two horizontal bands; actually redraw one broader continuous earth surface with uneven scattered details. No shiny mud, water, slime, fog or gradients. This is one reusable soil bed BEHIND cemetery crosses, not a walkable ledge. Preserve the fine scale of individual pebbles/leaves while expanding the quiet soil area.
images.export: Upper 280 rows of the visible soil bed at full source width, aspect-preserving native width 560; binary alpha 128.

images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / terrain extension. The supplied path sprite is the existing APPROVED upper ground. Create ONLY a companion underground earth texture to extend downward beneath that path, WITHOUT drawing any walkable path, grass top, bricks, platform rim or a green background. Output a wide opaque rectangular soil material plate, approximately 4:1 width:height. Fill the ENTIRE image edge to edge with finely detailed clustered PIXEL ART of neutral charcoal grey-brown earth, embedded fractured dark grey pebbles and stone fragments, a few irregular thin branching tree roots entering from the upper edge and thinning downward. Match the reference path's underground stone and root colors exactly; this is dry shaded cemetery earth, not bright orange clay or sand. Roots sparse and asymmetrical, small stones irregular and angular, no evenly spaced round dots, no repeating mirrored motifs. Quiet dark texture with subtle visible variation, modest contrast, fine pixel clusters rather than smooth painting, no gradients, no vignette, no lighting hotspot. Upper edge and lower edge both fully soil-colored, no alpha holes, no solid-color borders. NO grass, flowers, ferns, trees, graves, buildings, skulls, mushrooms, UI or text. No moss blanket, no green glow, no water or slime. This material will sit UNDER the approved path and continue down to the screen edge; it should not look like another raised platform or a deep cave. Preserve a consistent material scale across the whole plate.
